title: Mini Granny Square Join Project
description: Turn four granny squares into one small finished project so the user completes something real.
expectationText: A small finishing project where you turn separate squares into one piece and practice simple joining with confidence.

steps.title: Make four squares
steps.instruction: Complete the basic granny square pattern four times.

steps.title: Arrange the squares
steps.instruction: Lay the four squares in a 2 by 2 layout with the right sides facing up.

steps.title: Join the first seam
steps.instruction: Use slip stitch or whip stitch to join the top two squares.

steps.title: Join the second seam
steps.instruction: Join the bottom two squares, then connect the rows together.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in all ends and lightly shape the finished piece.
